verdict.rationale: Fern's core value proposition is generating API reference docs from an OpenAPI spec, confirmed by docs and its own live openapi.json being served, plus CLI tooling for validating/regenerating specs and preview/publish workflows that keep docs synced as the spec changes. Missing for 10: no explicit hands-on demonstration of the sync-on-change workflow (e.g., editing a spec and confirming the docs auto-update) beyond documentation claims.
